manifest.name: reference-v1
manifest.description: Fixed diagnostic cases. Keep this version unchanged when comparing checkpoints.

cases.name: clean
cases.description: Two competing senders without random loss, corruption, or jitter.

cases.name: lossy
cases.description: The standard benchmark, including 1% wire corruption in both directions.

cases.name: changing
cases.description: Capacity falls and recovers while both directions experience a temporary outage.

cases.name: stress
cases.description: Four longer transfers with 10% data/ACK loss, an outage, and a small bottleneck queue.
